resources.string: Choose a provider for future dictation. After choosing, tap dictation again to start. Selection and cancellation do not record audio or change your draft.
Android’s selected speech service takes priority. Otherwise use your White Noise choice, or the only available engine.
No speech provider found. Install and enable a speech provider, complete its setup, then return here. A keyboard may offer voice typing directly in its own controls.
Open White Noise to recover dictation. Retained audio is temporary and can be lost if Android stops the app.
Background protection ended. Open White Noise to recover retained dictation.
Transcription stopped before it finished. Review the recognized text in the draft before sending.
Recording stopped. Some audio is not transcribed.
Retry transcribes the retained audio without recording or sending. Audio is temporary and can be lost if Android stops the app.
Discard untranscribed audio? Text already in the composer stays.
Could not check the retained audio. Keep it and try again.
Finish dictation in the original conversation.
